sourceDelta.method: Read-only check: hash the actual current working tree, then recompute in this disposable process with only this one file read supplied from HEAD. That file was unchanged from HEAD before D028. The recomputed whole code identity exactly equals the observed pre-repair gate identity. Restore the read binding and confirm the current identity again. No repository bytes or gate row are changed; this diagnostic is not a passing gate and cannot authorize reuse at a different identity.

method: Full existing execution-ordered case-end events retained by a measurement-only gate-child-stdout preload during required review ordinal 1, before the independent host-guard fixture repair. The whole-code source-delta proof limits that later change to scripts/test-host-guard.test.mjs; profiled target source is unchanged. This is not a final-source whole-gate profile. The earlier reporter-stdout attempt during plain ordinal 5 produced no file; that passing timing remains retained and was not rerun for profiling. The retained review profile uses a larger selection than the five plain observations, with each task and its peers recorded. Instrumentation appends a small JSON row per selected case and has uncalibrated overhead included in the retained timings. Cases and files overlap; durations are not added to infer wall savings. Host contention is retained in measurements.json.
